name: Tomatoes Are a Kind of Fruit
source:
In the fraught aftermath of a breakup, Tom makes an impulsive decision that takes him back to the quirky queer seaside town he grew up in, to reunite with an old flame. From childhood best friends, to first-time lovers, and finally, just two people who keep failing to stay in touch, neither is sure what to call this thing they have between them anymore. Time has changed them both. Does the label even matter?

A queer romance featuring a transmasc love interest. It's also about how breakups suck. And depression. And chips.

Featuring: a sad protagonist & his hot tiger ex, who maybe still have feelings for each other?

[From [url=https://birdsongchoir.itch.io/tomatoes-are-a-kind-of-fruit]Itch.io[/url]]
